examples.arabic: كان فيه طفل اسمه كريم بيسأل اسئلة كتير كل يوم الصبح
examples.english: There was a child named Karim who asked many questions every morning
examples.transliteration: Kan fi tefl esmo Karim biyes'al as'ela kiteer kol yom el sobh

examples.english: There is a small child, his name is Karim.

examples.arabic: طفل صغير بيشوف سمكة جديدة في طبق
examples.english: A small child sees a new fish in a dish.
examples.transliteration: Tefl saghir beyshoof samaka gideeda fi tabaq.

examples.english: Ahmed is a small child who asks a lot.
The small child wants to eat more.
examples.transliteration: El tefl el soghayyar 'ayez ya'kol tani.

examples.arabic: سيف طفل شاطر بس بيسأل كتير قوي كل يوم
examples.english: Seif is a clever child but he asks a lot of questions every day.
examples.transliteration: Seif tifl shater bas biyes'al keteer awi kol yom
